moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-pointer-reveal-card, written here): Card 276 × 118 px, radius 10; front text (ink) and back text (accent), 44 px, same centre. Divider x follows the cursor x inside the card (else the left edge) with a 0.4 s power2.out response. Right of it the front text; left the back text plus faint accent scanlines every 6 px (6 %). Divider 1.5 px accent with a 6 × 20 px handle. Cursor enters left 0.85 s, sweeps to the right edge by 2.1 s, nudges 3.0 s, leaves 3.35 s (divider returns in 0.4 s). Loop 4.4 s. Params: chữ mặt trước / mặt sau · thời gian trả về (0.4 s) · vạch chia (1.5 px). Left of the divider shows the back text with faint accent scanlines, right of it the front; outside the card the divider returns to the left edge.
